dict.string: Doftar lists and manages the files on your Desktop.
Doftar lists and manages the files in your Documents folder.
Doftar lists and manages the files in your Downloads folder.
Doftar lists and manages the files on external drives.
Doftar lists and manages the files on network shares.
Doftar asks Finder to put back items that were moved to the Trash outside Doftar.
